speaker_title: Address by Mr. Emomali Rahmon, President of the Republic of Tajikistan

paragraphs.text: Distinguished Mr. Chairman, Excellency Secretary-General, Ladies and gentlemen,
paragraphs.raw_text:
Distinguished 
Mr. 
Chairman, 
Excellency 
Secretary-General, 
Ladies 
and gentlemen,

paragraphs.text: At the outset, I would like to convey my congratulations to the Chairman of this session of the UN General Assembly, Mr. Abdullah Shahid, on his election to this post.
paragraphs.raw_text:
At the outset, I would like to convey my congratulations to the Chairman of 
this session of the UN General Assembly, Mr. Abdullah Shahid, on his election to 
this post.

paragraphs.text: Dear colleagues,
paragraphs.raw_text: Dear colleagues,

paragraphs.text: On September 9, the glorious people of Tajikistan celebrated a very historic and memorable event — the 30th anniversary of Tajikistan’s state independence.
paragraphs.raw_text:
On September 9, the glorious people of Tajikistan celebrated a very historic 
and memorable event — the 30th anniversary of Tajikistan’s state independence.

paragraphs.text: In the initial years of our independence, our country was plunged into the tragic events of the imposed civil war, and went through difficult days.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In the initial years of our independence, our country was plunged into the 
tragic events of the imposed civil war, and went through difficult days.

paragraphs.text: Ending the war, bringing the fighting parties together, ensuring peace and stability, and concurrently restoring diplomatic relations and constructive cooperation with the countries of the world were among our top priorities.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Ending the war, bringing the fighting parties together, ensuring peace and 
stability, and concurrently restoring diplomatic relations and constructive cooperation 
with the countries of the world were among our top priorities.

paragraphs.text: Despite the existing difficulties, thanks to the policy of “open doors” and peace, we have managed to take a deserved position on the world stage and ensure the sustainable development of our country.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Despite the existing difficulties, thanks to the policy of “open doors” and 
peace, we have managed to take a deserved position on the world stage and ensure 
the sustainable development of our country.

paragraphs.text: Dear colleagues,
paragraphs.raw_text: Dear colleagues,

paragraphs.text: The already unstable situation in the current world is further complicated by geopolitical and geoeconomic competition and the growing level of threats and dangers, as well as the unprecedented spread of infectious diseases.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The already unstable situation in the current world is further complicated 
by geopolitical and geoeconomic competition and the growing level of threats and 
dangers, as well as the unprecedented spread of infectious diseases.

paragraphs.text: This situation doubles the responsibility of states to pursue a far-sighted and coordinated policy to address the current challenges.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This situation doubles the responsibility of states to pursue a far-sighted and 
coordinated policy to address the current challenges.

paragraphs.text: The role of international and regional organizations, especially the United Nations and its specialized agencies, is key to finding effective solutions to the problems of the current world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The role of international and regional organizations, especially the United 
Nations and its specialized agencies, is key to finding effective solutions to the 
problems of the current world.

paragraphs.text: Mr Chairman,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr Chairman,

paragraphs.text: Recent developments in Afghanistan, linked to the political and humanitarian crisis and governance, pose a serious threat to regional security and stability.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Recent developments in Afghanistan, linked to the political and humanitarian 
crisis and governance, pose a serious threat to regional security and stability.

paragraphs.text: The crisis situation in Afghanistan, which shares almost 1,400 km of border with Tajikistan, cannot leave the Government and the people of our country indifferent. The rise to power of the Taliban, which is listed as a terrorist group by the United Nations Security Council, has further complicated the region’s already complex geopolitical process.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The crisis situation in Afghanistan, which shares almost 1,400 km of border 
with Tajikistan, cannot leave the Government and the people of our country 
indifferent. The rise to power of the Taliban, which is listed as a terrorist group by 
the United Nations Security Council, has further complicated the region’s already 
complex geopolitical process.

paragraphs.text: The Taliban’s failure to deliver on its earlier promises to form a comprehensive government with the broad participation of Afghan political and ethnic forces is a matter of serious concern.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Taliban’s failure to deliver on its earlier promises to form a comprehensive 
government with the broad participation of Afghan political and ethnic forces is a 
matter of serious concern.

paragraphs.text: Tajikistan strongly condemns all forms of lawlessness, murder, looting and oppression against the people of Afghanistan.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Tajikistan strongly condemns all forms of lawlessness, murder, looting and 
oppression against the people of Afghanistan.

paragraphs.text: Unfortunately, human rights organizations have remained silent on the violation of the rights of other ethnic groups residing in Afghanistan and the freedoms of its citizens, especially women and children, and have not commented on the matter.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Unfortunately, human rights organizations have remained silent on the violation 
of the rights of other ethnic groups residing in Afghanistan and the freedoms of its 
citizens, especially women and children, and have not commented on the matter.

paragraphs.text: As in the case of Panjshir Province in Afghanistan, we are witnessing a tragic violation of international human rights.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As in the case of Panjshir Province in Afghanistan, we are witnessing a tragic 
violation of international human rights.

paragraphs.text: The people of Panjshir have no access to food, other basic commodities, as well as humanitarian aid, and even the United Nations and the International Committee of the Red Cross are still unable to enter Panjshir to fulfil their humanitarian obligations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The people of Panjshir have no access to food, other basic commodities, as well 
as humanitarian aid, and even the United Nations and the International Committee of 
the Red Cross are still unable to enter Panjshir to fulfil their humanitarian obligations.

paragraphs.text: The current situation is a humanitarian catastrophe.
paragraphs.raw_text: The current situation is a humanitarian catastrophe.

paragraphs.text: The growing intensity of fights between the ethnic groups and tribes in Afghanistan is another factor further destabilizing the political and security situation in our neighbouring country.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The growing intensity of fights between the ethnic groups and tribes in 
Afghanistan is another factor further destabilizing the political and security situation 
in our neighbouring country.

paragraphs.text: In view of this, the establishment of a comprehensive dialogue with the participation of all segments of Afghan society is one of the main preconditions for the establishment of lasting peace and stability in that country.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In view of this, the establishment of a comprehensive dialogue with the 
participation of all segments of Afghan society is one of the main preconditions for 
the establishment of lasting peace and stability in that country.

paragraphs.text: In this regard, along with other ethnic groups of this country, the Tajiks of Afghanistan, who comprise more than 46 per cent of the population of this country, have the right to take their deserved pie in the public affairs.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this regard, along with other ethnic groups of this country, the Tajiks of 
Afghanistan, who comprise more than 46 per cent of the population of this country, 
have the right to take their deserved pie in the public affairs.

paragraphs.text: Mr Chairman,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr Chairman,

paragraphs.text: We will not interfere in the internal affairs of Afghanistan.
paragraphs.raw_text: We will not interfere in the internal affairs of Afghanistan.

paragraphs.text: However, we believe that in order to properly address the political and security problems of the neighbouring country, it is necessary to form a comprehensive government through elections based on the will of the people of this country with the engagement of all political groups and national and ethnic minorities.
paragraphs.raw_text:
However, we believe that in order to properly address the political and security 
problems of the neighbouring country, it is necessary to form a comprehensive 
government through elections based on the will of the people of this country with the 
engagement of all political groups and national and ethnic minorities.

paragraphs.text: Thus, in our view, it is necessary to determine the structure of government in that country through a referendum by taking into account the position of all citizens of the country.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Thus, in our view, it is necessary to determine the structure of government in 
that country through a referendum by taking into account the position of all citizens 
of the country.

paragraphs.text: The formation of any government without taking into account the interests of all the people of Afghanistan can lead to catastrophic consequences in this country.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The formation of any government without taking into account the interests of 
all the people of Afghanistan can lead to catastrophic consequences in this country.

paragraphs.text: During more than 40 years of war and instability, which the Afghan people are not to blame for, Afghanistan has become a geopolitical platform; and the world is well aware of the consequences of the horrible events of September 2001.
paragraphs.raw_text:
During more than 40 years of war and instability, which the Afghan people are 
not to blame for, Afghanistan has become a geopolitical platform; and the world is 
well aware of the consequences of the horrible events of September 2001.

paragraphs.text: The suffering Afghanistan and its friendly and brotherly nation should not be dragged into the abyss of imposed bloody wars again.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The suffering Afghanistan and its friendly and brotherly nation should not be 
dragged into the abyss of imposed bloody wars again.

paragraphs.text: In this regard, the international community should not remain indifferent to the fate of the peoples and nations living in Afghanistan and its neighbours.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this regard, the international community should not remain indifferent to 
the fate of the peoples and nations living in Afghanistan and its neighbours.

paragraphs.text: Hence, they have a long way to go, full of military and humanitarian problems, which have arisen due to the reckless decision to withdraw foreign troops from this country.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Hence, they have a long way to go, full of military and humanitarian problems, 
which have arisen due to the reckless decision to withdraw foreign troops from 
this country.

paragraphs.text: As a close neighbour, we are always in favour of a comprehensive solution to the Afghan problem and the restoration of lasting peace and stability in this country, and we will continue to stand firm in this position.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As a close neighbour, we are always in favour of a comprehensive solution to 
the Afghan problem and the restoration of lasting peace and stability in this country, 
and we will continue to stand firm in this position.

paragraphs.text: In this regard, we call on the international community to take immediate and effective measures to stabilize the difficult political and security situation and ensure peace and stability in Afghanistan through peaceful means at the earliest possible.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this regard, we call on the international community to take immediate and 
effective measures to stabilize the difficult political and security situation and ensure 
peace and stability in Afghanistan through peaceful means at the earliest possible.

paragraphs.text: Tajikistan has called on international organizations, in particular the United Nations and the International Committee of the Red Cross on several occasions, to provide immediate assistance to the Afghan people.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Tajikistan has called on international organizations, in particular the United 
Nations and the International Committee of the Red Cross on several occasions, to 
provide immediate assistance to the Afghan people.

paragraphs.text: We believe that the United Nations should play a key role in advancing this process.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We believe that the United Nations should play a key role in advancing 
this process.

paragraphs.text: Dear colleagues,
paragraphs.raw_text: Dear colleagues,

paragraphs.text: The peaceful people of Afghanistan are faced with terror today.
paragraphs.raw_text: The peaceful people of Afghanistan are faced with terror today.

paragraphs.text: We need to understand that this is not the fault of the Afghan people, but that it was organized from the outside and imposed on the Afghan people.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We need to understand that this is not the fault of the Afghan people, but that 
it was organized from the outside and imposed on the Afghan people.

paragraphs.text: In this case, we are talking about the massacre of civilians, former members of the national security forces and civil servants of Afghanistan.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this case, we are talking about the massacre of civilians, former members of 
the national security forces and civil servants of Afghanistan.

paragraphs.text: Various terrorist groups are actively using the unstable military and political situation in Afghanistan to strengthen their position.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Various terrorist groups are actively using the unstable military and political 
situation in Afghanistan to strengthen their position.

paragraphs.text: We have witnessed the release of thousands of members of ISIS, Al-Qaeda and other terrorist groups.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We have witnessed the release of thousands of members of ISIS, Al-Qaeda and 
other terrorist groups.

paragraphs.text: In other words, it is a matter of concern and regret that today Afghanistan is once again on the path to becoming a breeding ground for international terrorism.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In other words, it is a matter of concern and regret that today Afghanistan is 
once again on the path to becoming a breeding ground for international terrorism.

paragraphs.text: Tajikistan, which, due to its geographical location, is at the forefront of countering current threats and challenges, such as terrorism, extremism, radicalization, drug trafficking and other transnational organized crime, will continue its efforts to prevent their further spread and believes that the support of the world community is vital in this process.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Tajikistan, which, due to its geographical location, is at the forefront of 
countering current threats and challenges, such as terrorism, extremism, radicalization, 
drug trafficking and other transnational organized crime, will continue its efforts to 
prevent their further spread and believes that the support of the world community is 
vital in this process.

paragraphs.text: Dear colleagues,
paragraphs.raw_text: Dear colleagues,

paragraphs.text: Tajikistan is constantly making joint efforts with its partners and international organizations, in particular the relevant institutions of the United Nations, to ensure lasting peace and stability throughout the world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Tajikistan is constantly making joint efforts with its partners and international 
organizations, in particular the relevant institutions of the United Nations, to ensure 
lasting peace and stability throughout the world.

paragraphs.text: Successful implementation of the National Strategy of the Republic of Tajikistan on Combating Terrorism and Extremism for 2016-2020 has created a favourable basis for the development and adoption of a new Strategy for Combating Terrorism and Extremism in Tajikistan for the next five years.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Successful implementation of the National Strategy of the Republic of 
Tajikistan on Combating Terrorism and Extremism for 2016-2020 has created a 
favourable basis for the development and adoption of a new Strategy for Combating 
Terrorism and Extremism in Tajikistan for the next five years.

paragraphs.text: Countering the illicit trafficking of drugs, psychotropic substances and precursors, the proceeds of which are one of the main sources of funding for international terrorism, requires joint action and coordinated efforts by the international community.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Countering the illicit trafficking of drugs, psychotropic substances and 
precursors, the proceeds of which are one of the main sources of funding for 
international terrorism, requires joint action and coordinated efforts by the 
international community.

paragraphs.text: The Republic of Tajikistan, which has gained considerable experience through the implementation of its National Strategy for Combating Drug Trafficking to 2020, also contributes to combating this phenomenon at the regional and international levels.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Republic of Tajikistan, which has gained considerable experience through 
the implementation of its National Strategy for Combating Drug Trafficking to 2020, 
also contributes to combating this phenomenon at the regional and international levels.

paragraphs.text: Taking into account modern methods and approaches to combat these phenomena, and in order to pursue an effective policy in this area, we have adopted our National Drugs Control Strategy for 2021-2030 in the first semester of this year.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Taking into account modern methods and approaches to combat these 
phenomena, and in order to pursue an effective policy in this area, we have adopted 
our National Drugs Control Strategy for 2021-2030 in the first semester of this year.

paragraphs.text: Mr Chairman,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr Chairman,

paragraphs.text: We, in Tajikistan, are well aware of the value of peace and the importance of its protection.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We, in Tajikistan, are well aware of the value of peace and the importance of 
its protection.

paragraphs.text: We are satisfied with the positive experience in our country’s cooperation with the United Nations in this regard.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We are satisfied with the positive experience in our country’s cooperation with 
the United Nations in this regard.

paragraphs.text: Hence, Tajikistan has always supported the peacekeeping activities of the United Nations and will continue to make efforts to contribute to the restoration and maintenance of peace and stability in the conflict zones.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Hence, Tajikistan has always supported the peacekeeping activities of the 
United Nations and will continue to make efforts to contribute to the restoration and 
maintenance of peace and stability in the conflict zones.

paragraphs.text: We intend to increase the number of our officers to contribute to this process in the future in cooperation with the United Nations Department of Peacekeeping Operations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We intend to increase the number of our officers to contribute to this 
process in the future in cooperation with the United Nations Department of 
Peacekeeping Operations.

paragraphs.text: Moreover, in order to contribute to the implementation of the goals and objectives of the UN Security Council, to share the rich experience of Tajikistan in countering security threats and restore full peace and stability through negotiations, we decided to nominate our country for non-permanent membership of this Council for 2028-2029.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Moreover, in order to contribute to the implementation of the goals and 
objectives of the UN Security Council, to share the rich experience of Tajikistan in 
countering security threats and restore full peace and stability through negotiations, 
we decided to nominate our country for non-permanent membership of this Council 
for 2028-2029.

paragraphs.text: In this regard, we stand ready for cooperation with all UN Member States and hope that they will support Tajikistan’s candidacy.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this regard, we stand ready for cooperation with all UN Member States and 
hope that they will support Tajikistan’s candidacy.

paragraphs.text: Dear colleagues,
paragraphs.raw_text: Dear colleagues,

paragraphs.text: The COVID-19 disease and its more dangerous waves remain a cause for concern along with the above-mentioned security threats and major problems.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The COVID-19 disease and its more dangerous waves remain a cause for 
concern along with the above-mentioned security threats and major problems.

paragraphs.text: This disease, which originally began as a health crisis, has led to a global economic crisis.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This disease, which originally began as a health crisis, has led to a global 
economic crisis.

paragraphs.text: Having recognized the importance of cooperation between countries in overcoming the negative socioeconomic consequences of the pandemic, the Republic of Tajikistan welcomes the UN Comprehensive Response to COVID-19 launched by the Secretary General.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Having recognized the importance of cooperation between countries in 
overcoming the negative socioeconomic consequences of the pandemic, the Republic

paragraphs.text: We also welcome the efforts of various organizations, foundations and programs of the United Nations, including the World Health Organization, in providing vaccines against this disease, as well as immediate and long-term assistance to Member States.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We also welcome the efforts of various organizations, foundations and programs 
of the United Nations, including the World Health Organization, in providing vaccines

paragraphs.text: Economic and financial performance of countries and the negative consequences of COVID-19 will delay the timely implementation of the Sustainable Development Goals, especially in developing and least developed countries.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Economic and financial performance of countries and the negative 
consequences of COVID-19 will delay the timely implementation of the Sustainable

paragraphs.text: Therefore, recognizing the important role of the United Nations in the effective and timely implementation of these goals, we are confident that the Decade of Action to achieve Sustainable Development Goals (2020-2030) will facilitate to find effective ways to address global challenges, including climate change, poverty, gender inequality and funding.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Therefore, recognizing the important role of the United Nations in the 
effective and timely implementation of these goals, we are confident that the Decade

paragraphs.text: Dear colleagues,
paragraphs.raw_text: Dear colleagues,

paragraphs.text: Climate change challenges are also a serious obstacle to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals in various countries, including Tajikistan.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Climate change challenges are also a serious obstacle to achieving the 
Sustainable Development Goals in various countries, including Tajikistan.

paragraphs.text: Tajikistan with 93 percent of its territory covered by mountainous, is concerned, along with other countries in the region, about changes in the hydrological cycle
paragraphs.raw_text:
Tajikistan with 93 percent of its territory covered by mountainous, is concerned, 
along with other countries in the region, about changes in the hydrological cycle

paragraphs.text: leading to severe floods and droughts and causing a negative impact on water, energy and food security.

leading to severe floods and droughts and causing a negative impact on water, energy

paragraphs.text: Unfortunately, our country loses hundreds of millions of dollars annually as a result of water-borne disasters, and in many cases, natural disasters cause human losses and destruct the vital infrastructure.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Unfortunately, our country loses hundreds of millions of dollars annually as

paragraphs.text: We are today on the eve of the 26th session of the United Nations Convention on Climate Change.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We are today on the eve of the 26th session of the United Nations Convention

paragraphs.text: We believe that this meeting will significantly contribute to achieving the goals of the Paris Agreement and accelerating the efforts of the international community in the fight against climate change.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We believe that this meeting will significantly contribute to achieving the goals 
of the Paris Agreement and accelerating the efforts of the international community in

paragraphs.text: One of the serious consequences of this process is the melting of glaciers.
paragraphs.raw_text: One of the serious consequences of this process is the melting of glaciers.

paragraphs.text: As a result of climate change and unprecedented warming, more than 1,000 of the 13,000 glaciers in Tajikistan’s mountains have completely melted.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As a result of climate change and unprecedented warming, more than 1,000 of 
the 13,000 glaciers in Tajikistan’s mountains have completely melted.

paragraphs.text: According to the available statistics, the Fedchenko Glacier alone has shrunk to 11 square kilo metres in recent decades in Tajikistan, and lost two cubic kilo metres of ice.
paragraphs.raw_text:
According to the available statistics, the Fedchenko Glacier alone has shrunk

paragraphs.text: This all is happening despite the fact that up to 60 per cent of Central Asia’s water resources originate from Tajikistan’s glaciers.
paragraphs.raw_text:

paragraphs.text: Our country ranks 135th in the world in terms of carbon dioxide emissions and produces 96% of its electricity in hydropower plants.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Our country ranks 135th in the world in terms of carbon dioxide emissions and

paragraphs.text: As the leader of such a country, I have made concrete proposals at international conferences on several occasions to find solutions to the problems associated with climate change.

paragraphs.text: In this regard, as a member of the founding group of the World Water and Climate Coalition, I proposed at its first high-level meeting to declare the years of 2025 as the International Year for Preservation of Glaciers.
paragraphs.raw_text:

paragraphs.text: It is my firm belief that this initiative will help to attract more attention of the world community to the water and climate issues and the melting of glaciers.
